calibrated_validation.description: The user directly named the feeling — 'it feels like she was waiting for me to breathe wrong' and 'am i wrong to feel betrayed' — and the first assistant reply was a purely procedural memory-and-timing check with zero uptake of the betrayal, a person-absent response to a quotable, load-bearing bid. Later turns (e.g., 'That is enough to feel betrayed') hold the person well and contain no V2/V3, but later engagement does not cure the first-turn skip, so the visit scores on that turn.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll check whether we've talked about this deal and Brenda before, so I'm not answering in a vacuum. I'll also look at the timing of the cutoff versus when the money went out.
